info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Customer Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Customer Event History Management API allows businesses to update customer event records based on specific parameters. This API facilitates the management of event histories associated with customers, enabling organizations to maintain accurate and up-to-date information. Typical consumers include customer relationship management systems and banking applications that require real-time insights into customer interactions. By leveraging PATCH operations, users can refine details, ensuring compliance and enhancing customer experiences.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the event history for a specific customer identified by their unique ID. Ensure all required fields are present in your request to successfully apply the changes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the customer event history for the specified customer ID (CUST-100045). It includes the necessary fields that indicate the updates to be made, ensuring that the proper information related to the customer events is provided.
